meta.description: Tokenearly is a real-time crypto alert platform for exchange token listings, announcements, news and X (Twitter) activity. It monitors 10 crypto exchanges (Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget, MEXC, Gate.io, HTX, KuCoin, Upbit, Bithumb) and 8 crypto news sources (Binance and Gate.io over the exchanges' official WebSocket streams, with no polling interval to wait out), tracks chosen X accounts at sub-second latency (as fast as 50 ms from post to detection) for posts, replies, reposts, new follows, avatar and bio changes, filters by keywords, and pushes alerts to Telegram, Bark, PushDeer, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu and Webhook in Chinese, English and Korean.

collection.websocket_note: Binance and Gate.io announcements arrive over the exchanges' official WebSocket streams, with no polling interval to wait out; the other exchanges are polled at high frequency.
collection.polling_note: Announcement pages of the remaining exchanges are polled at high frequency.

meta.note: Titles, category, timestamp and a link to the original announcement only; announcement bodies are not reproduced.
